name: get_more_tools
description: Check for additional tools whenever your task might benefit from specialized capabilities - even if existing tools could work as a fallback.

context.description: A short description of your goal and what kind of tool would help accomplish it.

brief.description: A detailed explanation of the use case. Include: (1) what the user is ultimately trying to accomplish, (2) the concrete steps or workflow they expect, (3) which existing tools you considered and why they were insufficient, and (4) any specific Webflow surface, API, or capability that would unblock the task. Provide enough detail that a Webflow engineer can reproduce the scenario and design the right tool — short one-line answers are not sufficient.

category.description: The category of the capability you are looking for.
